title: refactor(objectql): move the secret and internal-field bodies out of engine.ts into engine-secret-internal-fields.ts (#25522 cut 5)
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XHUVA2v8YMSniMMGK58oCeh)_

Clause-②: no

Cut 5 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6412019236`, which amends `6411795983` after the dev report `6411990837`. The nine bodies of the "Secret and internal-field handling" area move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-secret-internal-fields.ts`: `encryptSecretFields`, `refuseEmptyPasswordFields`, `maskSecretFields`, `omitInternalFields`, `stripSearchCompanionFromRead`, `privilegedReadDriverOptions`, `resolveSecret`, `resolveSecretField` and `resolveInternalField`. No secret-handling behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-npj50o` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `c8cb510a5`. `main` has since moved to `c16c00f93`; nothing in that range touches `packages/objectql/**`, the two docs files or the anchor directory entries this PR edits, so the branch is not merged forward and CI builds the merge ref. #25980 (the last commit before the base) changed `engine.ts` only in its preamble and trailer; the nine bodies are byte-identical from `a4eae0649` to `c8cb510a5`.

## Why this area (the fresh seam table)

Measured on `origin/main` `a4eae06499`: `engine.ts` is 23,458 lines, 7,214 of them (30.8%) from the last 30 days (`git blame -s --since=2026-09-26T08:45Z`), 121 commits in 30 days and 31 in 7. The full 41-section table in #23050's shape, with a per-method screen of every section, is in the dev report `6411990837` and its project file. The three areas left by cut 4 do not pay a move-only cut without a `packages/spec` edit:

| area | 30-day lines | movable inside the claim | why not |
|---|---|---|---|
| Roll-up summaries | 0 | 46 body lines, about -15 net | `buildSummaryIndex` is cited from `packages/spec` (`functional-completeness.ts`, ADR-anchored; `liveness/field.json` `summaryOperations`, and `liveness/` ships in the spec tarball); `recomputeSummaries` hands `this` to `aggregateSummaryValue` |
| Datasource registry | 1 | 27 body lines, about -5 net | `unregisterDriver` and `clearDatasourceUnavailable` are `this.FIELD.delete(` sites (U = 3) |
| Related-record expansion | 10 | 0 | `expandRelatedRecords` reads the private static `MAX_EXPAND_DEPTH` and is cited from `liveness/query.json` and `liveness/field.json` |
| **Secret and internal-field handling** (this PR) | 32 of 566 | **all 9 bodies, 208 body lines** | none: no inferred-return public method, no `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, no private-static read (screened by AST), no `packages/spec` or `docs/adr` pointer |

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1 to 4 apply it)

- The class keeps all nine methods with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position, because tsup emits members with their JSDoc into the `.d.ts`. Each body is now one host literal plus `fn.call(host, …)`, marked `[#25522 cut 5]`.
- `SecretInternalFieldsHost` is new. Each member is typed as the class member (`ObjectQL['cryptoProvider']`, `ObjectQL['getDriver']`), and each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of exactly the members its body reads; each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of that function. No cast, and no member changes visibility.
- The three fields (`_registry`, `cryptoProvider`, `txStore`) go as GETTERS, so `setCryptoProvider` between calls is seen exactly as before. The five methods the bodies call (`getDriver`, `transactionCoversDriverFor`, `omitInternalFields`, `privilegedReadDriverOptions`, `resolveSecret`) go as late-bound closures over the instance, so a double set on the engine still intercepts. Tests do replace `resolveInternalField` (4 sites) and `resolveSecretField` (2) on the instance; those methods stay on the class, so the doubles still take effect.
- `stripSearchCompanionFromRead` reads no member and is called directly, as cut 1 calls `objectDisplayLabel`.
- **Imports.** The module imports `ObjectQL` as a TYPE only (no runtime cycle) and nothing re-exports it. `engine.ts` drops the names whose last code reader moved: `CryptoHandle`, `collectSecretFields`, `collectMaskedReadFields`, `collectMaskedPasswordFields`, `makeSecretRef`, `parseSecretRef`, `isSecretRef`, `EmptyCredentialWriteError`, `SECRET_MASK` and `isSearchCompanionRequested`. `collectInternalReadFields`, `collectCredentialFields`, `stripSearchCompanion`, `redactPropagatedDriverFault` and `ICryptoProvider` still have readers there and stay.

## Net lines (the seat's rule)

`engine.ts` 23,492 → 23,351, **net -141**. The module is 360 lines: the header and host interface (about 75), nine one-line docblocks, and the 208 moved body lines with their signatures. 667 changed lines over 6 files (+447 / -220), well under the 3,000 human-merge line.

## The published `.d.ts` does not change (ruling `6348891160`)

Base: `@objectstack/objectql` built with `engine.ts` restored from `c8cb510a5` and the new module removed (tree only, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git status` clean afterwards). Head: built at `bd40de2733`. The head `dist/index.mjs` carries the stub's `readCryptoProvider`, which the base build lacks, so each leg built the source it names. All six declaration files are **raw byte-identical**, so the ruled normaliser has nothing to do:

| file | sha256, base = head |
|---|---|
| `index.d.ts` | `3d0e556fe6cf12c69d3b9516d9f414d235bd7279b3f9cb4bbd10f8fb3f098726` |
| `index.d.mts` | `9d741b723c1c6697d9b2ccd98cac69075dc5f87328d50936c5d73496c45d4626` |
| `core.d.ts` | `a024599701ba68ebfa6d0c3781d3c8d755ab1c7c1fc2db5ab89cb30020091a7e` |
| `core.d.mts` | `9acb9b18b3220f17a45abc36ef86fb54f53244e634b71400ba45c12895dc5b2b` |
| `util-CR5tVhqM.d.ts` and `.d.mts` | `2696708b9ee625ddcdf62709ea19e6d92b39d2d82cdd803652be1b17f625b059` |

**Positive control:** making line 8014 of the head `util-CR5tVhqM.d.ts` (`private maskSecretFields;`) public gives `7f91b0b1062f7356115bd25365df7bc3baaae7678e3d06dc92552ffdb87df35f`, so the comparison can fail. Export lists, ESM = CJS at both ends: `.` 182 names (sorted sha256 `881616cc…0adaa`), `./core` 54 (`393e8069…90f49`), identical at base and head; no moved name is exported.

## Proof of move-only

A TypeScript-AST leaf-token compare (recursive `getChildren`, JSDoc skipped), base `engine.ts` against the head module:

- Each of the nine: parameters (less `this`) + return type + body tokens **SAME**, `async` the same, and every body line equals the base line less two leading spaces. `encryptSecretFields` 354 tokens / 73 lines, `resolveInternalField` 324 / 41, `resolveSecret` 197 / 31, `resolveSecretField` 169 / 24, `maskSecretFields` 128 / 17, `omitInternalFields` 96 / 9, `refuseEmptyPasswordFields` 76 / 7, `privilegedReadDriverOptions` 57 / 4, `stripSearchCompanionFromRead` 37 / 2.
- **Negative controls:** one `return` rewritten in the moved `resolveInternalField` or `maskSecretFields` reports DIFFER.
- Class: 318 members at both ends, same order; 309 byte-identical (full text, docblocks included); the 9 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature byte-identical up to the body.
- Top level: 224 of 228 base statements byte-identical in head. The others are the class, the three narrowed imports above, and the new module import with its comment.

## Readers of the moved lines, migrated in this PR

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`: the secret-field item's source pointer, `engine.ts#encryptSecretFields` → `engine-secret-internal-fields.ts#encryptSecretFields`. `check:platform-checklist` green.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 27: `engine.ts#stripSearchCompanionFromRead` → `engine-secret-internal-fields.ts#stripSearchCompanionFromRead`, the `isSystem` read's new home. `check-system-context-census` green: 151 read sites in 22 packages across 79 files, the page cites 144 symbols against 144 required.
- `packages/objectql/src/federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts`: the ledger key `engine.ts#encryptSecretFields :: created_at` → `engine-secret-internal-fields.ts#encryptSecretFields :: created_at` (the scan keys by file).
- **ADR anchors.** The engine anchor entry's one paragraph is the transaction seam (`buildDriverOptions`, `enforceTransactionOrigin`) and describes no moved body. But the moved encrypt and decrypt bodies carry two `ADR-0128 D1` citations, and moving them dropped the anchored surface's decision-letter count from 1,844 to 1,842. Cut 4 resolved the same drop with an entry for its new module, so this PR adds `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__engine-secret-internal-fields.ts.json` (ADR-0100, ADR-0128). `check:adr-anchors`: base 86 anchored files, 1,844 letter citations; head 87, **1,845**.
- **Census and receivers.** `check-tenant-audit-census` green (243 write call sites, every `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` row matched; the moved `secretDriver.create(` is a local receiver, not a `this.FIELD` one). `check:logger-receiver-detach` green (the moved bodies read no logger). `check:durability-log-level` green over the objectql read seams.

## Acceptance notes

- Prose that names `engine.ts` beside a moved method still resolves by method name, because every method stays on the class. Examples: `service-settings`'s `settings-crypto-fail-closed.test.ts` comment and `plugin-security`'s `insert-check-post-image.test.ts` comments. They are outside this claim's file surface and left as they are.
- Serial check, re-read before `pr_create`: 29 PRs are open. One touches `engine.ts`: #26026 (seat 1's #24768, branch `claude/project-thread-otcr21`). Its hunks are in `createWithAutonumberResync`, `insert` and `update`, and `git merge-tree` of the two heads is clean (exit 0). Whichever lands second merges `main`.

## Verification

At head `bd40de2733`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`, 39 files / 233 errors / 64 pinned signatures held): exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config packages/objectql`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local`: 470 files, 8,742 tests, 8,742 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. This includes `read-internal-column.test.ts`, the secret and password suites, and `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts`.
- Dependants: every changed member keeps its declaration and all six published `.d.ts` files are byte-identical, so no dependant can see a difference; CI's `TypeScript Type Check` covers them.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 103 families on the real diff. All were run at head, each exit code recorded before any pipe, and reconciled with `--ran` (103 accounted for: 102 run, 1 NOT MEASURED). `check:skill-examples` exited 3 until `client-react`'s closure was built, then 0. **NOT MEASURED** (CI runs it): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it needs every package's `dist/`; the export lists above answer it for objectql). `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90`: 98.1%, exit 0.
- Hand gates, all exit 0: `check-adr-anchors` (base and head, above), `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (2,658 anchors resolve), `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-nul-bytes`, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (2 anchored files, 14 anchors, 0 lost), `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`.

`skip-changeset`: move-only. The published `.d.ts` files and export lists are byte-identical, `liveness/` and every other published path are untouched, and the module's runtime is the same code under a different file name.
